doc: Share of the variance lost by a 2x2 box average brought back bilinearly (rows clamp, columns wrap): the image is converted to float64 first, then every step is float64 (floor, clip, bilinear lerp, population variance), so a port is within 1e-9 (numpy against exactly rounded math.fsum sums: < 5e-16 relative). An isotropic generated map. Input convention: the u8 input(s) img are maps stored as bytes, and the function receives them as float32(u8) / float32(255) (`u8.astype(np.float32) / 255.0`: the division is done, and correctly rounded, in float32, as measure.load reads an 8-bit map), NOT as the raw bytes and NOT as a float64 quotient (a texel on a histogram edge or a threshold would move). params.u8_inputs lists them.

u8_inputs.img: float32(u8) / float32(255), the division in float32
